explanation: States that for every t ≥ 2, liminf_{d→∞} h_t(d)/d^t ≥ 1 (Cames van Batenburg–Korsky 2026), as ∀ ε > 0, eventually (1 − ε)d^t ≤ h_t(d). This strengthens the CCJK conjecture recorded on erdosproblems.com/934 ('h_t(d) ≥ (1 − o(1))d^t for infinitely many d', stated there for t ≥ 3). The encoding is correct. Faithful.
